baseline_selection: WDL40 only if the frozen main 1600-game gate promotes it; otherwise WDL25. This conditional rule is fixed before either verdict. Do not choose from this follow-up's scores.
admission: Require the entire main match queue COMPLETE, both exports' hash-bound parity receipts, at least 9000 seconds before the deadline, and physical C: headroom >=25 GiB. Never overlap the main matches or change their instrument.

matches.name: e20-aa
matches.decision: Require all audits and paired 95% score interval containing parity; failure blocks the scored cell.

matches.name: e20-gate
matches.roles: Final recovered e20 versus the selected baseline
matches.decision: Promote only if all audits pass and the paired 95% Elo lower bound is positive at exactly 800 games. Otherwise retain the selected baseline; no extension or partial pooling.

interpretation: e20 uses a zero game-result weight and twice the nominal update cap; this compares complete candidates and cannot isolate an epoch effect. The Counter long-clock anchor remains WDL25 regardless of this result.
lifecycle: Before follow-up games, smoke the selected baseline at Threads=8 on actual Linux and Windows binaries: fixed-node searches, stop/restart, new-game barriers, scale and width changes, legal root moves, empty stderr and normal exit. This provides no SMP Elo estimate.
stop_rules: A failed control, capacity guard, deadline or process interruption leaves the affected cell unscored. Preserve failed evidence. A time-based admission skip carries no playing verdict. Native Rodent remains held pending independent reproduction and a mechanism-bound compatibility rule.
